mentions.name: TonePilot
mentions.description: A macOS-native desktop app that controls Positive Grid Spark guitar amps from a computer without needing a phone. It offers faster and more reliable amp control than the official mobile-only app, and supports multiple Spark amp models, with ~50 people using it so far.
mentions.problem: The official Positive Grid Spark app is mobile-only and clunky, with an awkward workflow when sitting at a desk. Maintaining compatibility across different amp models is also hard, since protocol changes for one amp can break another, requiring extensive manual testing before every release.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a MacOS-native app [1] to control Positive Grid Spark amps [2], without needing a phone.
